attributes.name: has-card-slat-group
attributes.description: Set when card slat group content exists, allowing the card body to apply the current Card size inset to grouped slats.

attributes.name: has-accordion-slat-group
attributes.description: Set when accordion slat group content exists, allowing the card body to tune internal spacing for grouped accordions.

attributes.name: inner-space
attributes.description: Set when default-slot content needs inset padding, including card slat groups. Not set when table or accordion layout owns the surface, and not set when size is none.

attributes.name: inner-space-top
attributes.description: Set by Card when a Header is present, allowing Card to collapse Body top padding so the sections sit flush.
